explication: Caveman reduces both agent output and context read: its principal workflow places a local proxy between a coding agent and an AI provider, compressing eligible request content while retaining originals for recovery. It also offers a reusable engine, app middleware, agent-facing tools, browser support, and durable memory. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with sampled engine, proxy, MCP, and browser entry points; some subsystem wiring is documented but its implementation was not sampled.
